INSERT INTO `basket_lines` ( `transaction_id` , `sku` , `quantity` , `unit_price_cents` , NAME ) VALUES (...) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `quantity` = `quantity` + ?

SELECT MAX ( CASE WHEN `sku` = ? THEN `unit_price_cents` END ) , MAX ( CASE WHEN `sku` = ? THEN NAME END ) , COALESCE ( SUM ( `quantity` ) , ? ) , COALESCE ( SUM ( `quantity` * `unit_price_cents` ) , ? ) FROM `basket_lines` WHERE `transaction_id` = ?

FROM `basket_lines` WHERE `transaction_id` = ? ) , STATUS , ? ) , `active_attempt_id` = IF ( `active_attempt_id` = ?, ... , `active_attempt_id` ) , `version` = `version` + ? WHERE `transaction_id` = ?

AND `b` . `transaction_id` = ? AND `l` . `reserved_quantity` > ? AND `b` . `quantity` > `l` . `reserved_quantity`
